name: gojq
description: Pure Go implementation of jq with superior Unicode handling, arbitrary-precision integers, and YAML support - handles large numbers without precision loss

gojq.description: Pure Go jq implementation with enhanced Unicode support, arbitrary-precision arithmetic, and YAML input/output - maintains precision for large integers unlike standard jq
gojq.usage:
gojq '.users[] | select(.age > 21)' data.json
echo '{"large": 12345678901234567890}' | gojq '.large' # Preserves precision
gojq --yaml-input --yaml-output '.services.web' docker-compose.yml
echo '[1,2,3]' | gojq 'map(. * 999999999999999999999)' # Arbitrary precision math
gojq '.items | length' huge-file.json # Consistent Unicode character counting
